# credibility score

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:credibilityScore`](gmeow-credibilityScore.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/credibilityScore>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A numerical credibility score assigned to an observation or claim. Solver-layer computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:credibilityScore`](gmeow-credibilityScore.md) from [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry a solver-computed credibility figure for an observation or claim — a derived scalar that downstream tooling can rank cues and standpoints by.

### Avoid when

- Avoid hand-authoring it as a first-class fact (it is a solver-layer derivation, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid reading it as a truth verdict — low credibility is not refutation; settle truth by refuting a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)'s modality, never with this score.

### How to use

- Let the solver write the [xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) score onto the [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md); carry the assessor and method on the observation's vantage/method, and keep this purely derived value out of public-facing projections.

### Examples

- ex:cueReading [`gmeow:credibilityScore`](gmeow-credibilityScore.md) 0.35.
